blind.description: A square floor trap framed by chunky, rounded grey stone blocks. Inside the recessed pit, numerous upright sharpened wooden stakes are planted in a dark brown floor. Along one edge, a section of broken, splintered wooden planks overhangs the pit, suggesting a collapsed or triggered false floor. Surfaces are solid, clean, and stylized with hand-painted textures, with no floating shards or untextured regions.
blind.from_above: A square stone border surrounding a dark recessed square interior, with jagged wooden floorboards covering the left edge and an orderly grid of sharpened wooden spike tips protruding across the center and right.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly 4 to 4.5 feet wide and long, and about 8 to 12 inches tall (around one-sixth the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure).
